notes.title: Bride into the Release Officially Released
notes.notes:
Hey guys,

Bride into the Cave is now fully released!

You can now enjoy 20% off in 14 days.

If there is any bug during your adventure into the cave, or if you want to share your feedbak with the developers, please send us an email to cavebride@gmail.com. 

Hope you will enjoy our game.

notes.title: The Release of Bride into the Cave is Postponed
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We'd like to thank you all for the concern and support you have shown for "Bride into the Cave". However, we sincerely apologize that the official release of our game will be slightly delayed by a couple of weeks.

As a group of newcomers, we have received attention far beyond our expectations in the past few months. We never could have imagined we would have gained such a large number of wishlists . Currently, we are working tirelessly to optimize every aspect of the game, and we will announce the final release date of the official version as soon as possible. 

Once again, we thank you for your continued understanding and support!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2604410/_/
